name: Blood Pressure Monitor
instruction: Create a blood pressure monitor with an inflatable cuff and a digital display unit. The cuff should be adjustable to fit different arm sizes and have a Velcro closure. The display unit should show systolic and diastolic pressure readings, as well as pulse rate. Include buttons for starting and stopping the measurement, as well as a memory function to store previous readings.

Shape accuracy: The object in the images is a blood pressure monitor.
The cuff is inflatable and adjustable.
Color representation: The color set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Size: The size set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Proportion: The cuff and unit are proportionate to the entire the monitor.
Texture and surface detail: The texture and surface detail set in the script is reasonable for the object.

Three-dimensional spatial awareness: The cuff is positioned correctly to wrap around an arm.
The display unit is placed in a visible position for easy reading.
The buttons are easily accessible on the display unit.
Object distance and contact: The cuff does not overlap with the display unit.
The Velcro closure is securely fastened without gaps.

Instruction execution accuracy: All specified components are accurately represented.
The cuff's adjustability and Velcro closure are correctly implemented.
The display unit functions as described with all necessary readings.
